Problem: Startup Examples for STM32WL33 targets
Context: repo=cmsis_device_wl, mcu_series=None, board=None, component=None, layer=Other, issue_kind=usage_question, severity=medium, evidence_strength=medium, rescue_applied=False, state=closed, issue_number=2
Root cause: Hello @xanthio, I apologize, I don't quite understand your point.
Fix: There is no startup example for STM32WL33 targets
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: usage_question, medium, question, cmsis, STM32WL33

Technical details:
There is no startup example for STM32WL33 targets

Key comments:
Hello @xanthio, I apologize, I don't quite understand your point. There isn't an STM32WL33 target within the STM32WL product. Could you please verify your concern? Rania STM32WL33 have active status on [STM32WL33 product page](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32wl3x/products.html) Hello @xanthio, Thank you for your contribution, there will be an **STM32CubeWL3** firmware, and the CMSIS for WL33 will be available within it. We cannot share a date for the moment. So, stay tuned and thank you once more for your contribution and for your patience. We are looking forward to reading from you again.

Problem: Remove non UTF-8 characters
Context: repo=cmsis_device_wl, mcu_series=None, board=None, component=None, layer=Other, issue_kind=other, severity=low, evidence_strength=medium, rescue_applied=False, state=closed, issue_number=1
Root cause: Hi @jeromecoutant, Thank you for reporting this report.
Fix: It is better to not introduce any text which is not UTF-8 encoded.
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: low, documentation, enhancement, cmsis, UTF-8

Technical details:
It is better to not introduce any text which is not UTF-8 encoded. $ grep -axv '.*' Device/ST/STM32WLxx/Include/* See https://github.com/ARMmbed/mbed-os/pull/15137/commits/5e7a7f4b4eb3f84b0286cb94c415fadff3aff627

Key comments:
Hi @jeromecoutant, Thank you for reporting this report. You are absolutely right about this point. An internal bug tracker has been opened. The fix will be made available in the frame of a future release. Thank you once more for your contribution. ST Internal Reference: 116028
